Dockerfile.text:
FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY engine.mjs pages.mjs stripe.mjs server.mjs ./
RUN mkdir -p /data && chown node /data
USER node
ENV PORT=8080 STATE=/tmp/state.json
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK CMD wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz || exit 1
CMD ["node", "server.mjs"]

README.md.text:
# Referral Keeper

After using this, you can now **run an affiliate or referral program on your own Stripe account**: affiliates share a link, the customers they bring earn them recurring commission, refunds and disputes claw it back, and you pay them from a CSV, with no monthly fee and no revenue share.

**Live tool:** https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/referral-keeper/

Two parts, both free and MIT:

- **`index.html`**: a programme planner. Type your price, commission, window, churn and referral volume and see what the programme costs month by month. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.
- **`server.mjs`**: one Node process, **zero dependencies**, state in one JSON file. It receives Stripe webhooks, keeps the ledger, serves the tracking script, a private dashboard per affiliate and an admin page. **It needs no Stripe API key and never calls Stripe or moves money.**

## Why someone would use this

| Today | Cost / catch | Referral Keeper |
|---|---|---|
| Rewardful, FirstPromoter, Tolt, PromoteKit and similar | Monthly fee or a share of tracked revenue; affiliates and customer data on their platform | Your server, no fee, one JSON file you own |
| A spreadsheet plus Stripe exports | Manual attribution, forgotten refunds, commissions paid twice | Attribution, windows, clawbacks and idempotency are automatic and tested |
| Stripe's own tools | No affiliate tracking or commission ledger | Reads the Stripe events you already have |

Honest limits: **it does not pay affiliates** (you pay from the CSV, then mark it paid), one admin key (no per-user logins), no affiliate marketplace, no multi-level commissions, no fraud scoring beyond self-referral and idempotency, attribution is last-click by default (`data-attribution="first"` for first-click), and attribution depends on the cookie or on you passing `client_reference_id`.

## How attribution works

1. Add `<script src="https://YOUR-SERVER/r.js" defer></script>` to your marketing site. A visit to `https://yoursite.com/?ref=ann` stores `ann` in a cookie **on your own domain** (60 days; `data-days`, `data-param` and `data-attribution="first"` change that) and counts one click.
2. Stripe **Payment Links** are tagged automatically (the script adds `client_reference_id=ref_ann` when the visitor clicks a `buy.stripe.com` link). For **Checkout Sessions** you create, pass `client_reference_id: "ref_" + code`. `referralKeeper.clientReferenceId()` gives you the value in the browser.
3. On `checkout.session.completed` the server attributes that Stripe customer (or, for guest checkout, that email) to the affiliate. The first affiliate keeps the customer. An affiliate's own email never earns.
4. Every `invoice.paid` for that customer earns `percent` of the amount paid **excluding tax**, for the first `months` payments (`0` = for life). One-time Checkout payments earn once.

## Money rules

- **Hold**: new commission becomes payable `holdDays` after the payment (default 30), so most refunds land before you pay.
- **Refunds** reduce the commission in proportion to the refunded share. **Disputes** withhold it, and a dispute you win restores it.
- **Clawbacks**: if the commission was already paid, the affiliate's balance goes negative and the next commissions absorb it.
- **Payouts**: one open payout per affiliate and currency once the payable balance reaches `minPayout`. Download `/admin/payouts.csv` (formula-injection-safe), pay it however you like, then mark it paid with a reference. A payout you did not send can be cancelled and its commissions become payable again.
- **Per-affiliate overrides** of percent and window, and manual adjustments over the API.

## Run it

```sh
cd ventures/referral-keeper
node --test        # no network
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_... ADMIN_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 16) \
PUBLIC_URL=https://refs.example.com SITE_URL=https://example.com \
PROGRAM_JSON='{"percent":20,"months":12,"holdDays":30,"minPayout":5000}' node server.mjs
```

Stripe webhook endpoint: `PUBLIC_URL/webhook/stripe` with `checkout.session.completed`, `checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded`, `invoice.paid`, `charge.refunded`, `charge.dispute.created`, `charge.dispute.closed`. Create affiliates at `/admin` (any user name, `ADMIN_KEY` as the password), or `POST /admin/affiliates` with `Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_KEY>` and JSON `{name, email, code?, percent?, months?}`. Each affiliate gets a private dashboard link (`/a/<token>`, also `.json`). `GET /v1/summary` gives totals.

Optional: `OPEN_SIGNUP=true` publishes `/join`; applicants start **pending** and earn nothing until you approve them. Other settings: `STATE` (JSON file path, keep it on a persistent disk), `PORT`, `COMPANY_NAME`, `TRUST_PROXY=true` behind a proxy, `HIDE_SPONSOR_LINK=true`. Money is stored as integer minor units; `minPayout` is in the same units (5000 = 50.00).

## One-click deploy

Fork the repository, then open `https://render.com/deploy?repo=<your fork URL>`. Render builds the Dockerfile in **your** account with a 1 GB disk and generates `ADMIN_KEY`; you paste the webhook signing secret and your public URL. Nothing runs on the author's accounts. The same Dockerfile runs on Fly.io, Railway or any VPS. Serve it over HTTPS only; the admin uses HTTP Basic auth.

## Disclaimer

No warranty; no uptime or delivery guarantee. You operate the programme and are responsible for your Stripe account, your terms with affiliates and customers, affiliate-disclosure rules (affiliates generally must disclose the relationship), any tax reporting on what you pay them, and data-protection rules. Commission figures come from Stripe events the server received; a missed or rejected webhook means a missed commission, so check against Stripe before paying. Not legal, tax or financial advice. MIT licensed. If it saves you a subscription, you can [sponsor the author](https://github.com/sponsors/Duncan-Haywood).

## Other self-deploy paths

`docker-compose.yml` runs it on any box with Docker (the command is at its top). Fly.io: the steps are at the top of `fly.toml`. Both keep state on a volume and run in your own account.

VENTURE.yaml.text:
name: referral-keeper
description: >-
  Self-hosted referral and affiliate program for Stripe sellers: a first-party
  tracking link, recurring commissions with a window, refund and dispute
  clawbacks, a hold period, affiliate dashboards and a payout CSV, all from
  your own Stripe webhook. Browser programme planner plus a zero-dependency
  server with a one-click Render deploy.
stage: prototype
owner: duncan

# Screened 2026-10-15. Paid market is real and proven: Rewardful, FirstPromoter,
# Tolt, PromoteKit, Dub and Stripe-connected affiliate apps all sell this to
# SaaS and course sellers, priced as a monthly fee or a share of tracked
# revenue. The gap: founders on plain Stripe who want the ledger, affiliate
# list and cookie data in their own account with no fee, and who pay
# affiliates by hand anyway. Fifth product for the same buyer as dunning-engine,
# cancel-flow, mrr-pulse and license-keeper (a Stripe seller of software).
# duplicate_check: waitlist-keeper is a pre-launch referral waitlist (invites,
# no money); no affiliate-commission venture existed.
#
# First visitor: indie founders on Indie Hackers, r/SaaS, r/stripe and
# Hacker News asking "rewardful alternative", "self hosted affiliate program
# stripe", "affiliate tracking stripe payment links". Volume not measured with
# an external tool.
#
# Path to revenue (payments stay off): free and MIT as the lead magnet;
# done-for-you setup, a hosted copy under the deployer's own name, or GitHub
# Sponsors are the paid steps; hosting under the public name and billing are
# owner-gated.

hypotheses:
  - claim: >-
      Founders who run a Stripe-based product will use the browser programme
      planner to size a referral programme and then deploy the server, because
      hosted affiliate tools charge a monthly fee or a share of tracked revenue
      before the programme has produced a single sale.
    status: untested
    checked: null
    evidence: customer-contact
  - claim: >-
      Clawbacks (refund, dispute, negative balance) and a hold period are what
      make a founder trust a self-run ledger over a spreadsheet.
    status: untested
    checked: null
    evidence: customer-contact

economics:
  currency: USD
  mrr: null
  monthly_cost: 0
  customers: null

budget:
  monthly_cap: 1
  protected: false

kill_criteria:
  - Fewer than three distinct GitHub users (issues, stars, or a pasted report) engage within 90 days of the page being reachable from the published site.
  - A user reports a commission paid twice for one payment, or a refunded payment that still pays out; the idempotency and clawback paths come before any new feature.

links:
  production: https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/referral-keeper/
  analytics: null

fly.toml.text:
# Fly.io self-deploy, in your own account (needs flyctl and a card on file with Fly):
#   fly launch --copy-config --no-deploy --dockerfile Dockerfile
#   fly volumes create state --size 1
#   fly secrets set ADMIN_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 16)
#   (optional settings from render.yaml, e.g. PUBLIC_URL, go in with `fly secrets set` too)
#   fly deploy
# One machine that never auto-stops: the state file lives on its volume.
app = "referral-keeper-CHANGE-ME"
primary_region = "iad"

[build]
  dockerfile = "Dockerfile"

[env]
  PORT = "8080"
  STATE = "/data/state.json"
  TRUST_PROXY = "true"
  PROGRAM_JSON = '{"percent":20,"months":12,"holdDays":30,"minPayout":5000}'
  OPEN_SIGNUP = "false"

[mounts]
  source = "state"
  destination = "/data"

[http_service]
  internal_port = 8080
  force_https = true
  auto_stop_machines = "off"
  auto_start_machines = false
  min_machines_running = 1
  [[http_service.checks]]
    path = "/healthz"
    interval = "30s"
    timeout = "5s"

index.html.text:
Let your customers sell for you, and keep the affiliate ledger in your own account.

Referral Keeper is the open-source server behind a referral or affiliate program on Stripe: a tracking link, recurring commissions, refund and dispute clawbacks, a hold period and a payout CSV. First plan what a program would cost you below. It runs in your browser, so nothing is uploaded.

1. What would a referral program cost me?

Commission paid in total
–
Share of referred revenue
–
Commission per referred customer
–
Kept after commission
–

Month by month (expected values, not a forecast)
MonthActiveRevenueCommission earnedPaid out so farStill owed

2. Make a link and the checkout snippet

Share link:

Add <script src="https://YOUR-SERVER/r.js" defer></script> to your site. Payment Links are tagged automatically. For Checkout Sessions you create, pass the code through:

const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
  mode: "subscription",
  line_items: [{ price: "price_123", quantity: 1 }],
  client_reference_id: ref,   // from referralKeeper.clientReferenceId() in the browser, sent with your request
  success_url: "https://example.com/thanks",
});

3. Run the server yourself

git clone https://github.com/Duncan-Haywood/fp-monorepo && cd fp-monorepo/ventures/referral-keeper
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_... ADMIN_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 16) \
PUBLIC_URL=https://refs.example.com SITE_URL=https://example.com \
PROGRAM_JSON='{"percent":25,"months":12,"holdDays":30,"minPayout":5000}' node server.mjs

Point a Stripe webhook at /webhook/stripe for checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, invoice.paid, charge.refunded, charge.dispute.created and charge.dispute.closed. It needs no Stripe API key. Add affiliates at /admin; each gets a private dashboard link. One-click Render deploy and Docker are in the README.

Questions

Why not use Rewardful, FirstPromoter or a Stripe app?

Hosted affiliate tools are polished and quick to set up, and some connect to Stripe in a few clicks. The trade-off is a monthly fee or a share of the revenue they track, and your affiliates and customer data living on their platform. Referral Keeper runs in your own account, reads only Stripe webhooks, and has no fee. It is leaner: no affiliate marketplace, no automatic payments to affiliates, one admin key. If a hosted tool already earns its fee for you, keep it.

How is a referral attributed to an affiliate?

A one-line script on your site stores the affiliate code from the link in a cookie on your own domain. Stripe Payment Links are tagged automatically; for Checkout Sessions you create, you pass the code as client_reference_id. When Stripe tells the server about the completed checkout, that customer belongs to the affiliate, and every later invoice for them earns commission until the window you set ends.

What happens on a refund or chargeback?

A refund reduces the commission in proportion. A dispute withholds it until the dispute closes in your favour. If the commission was already paid out, the affiliate's balance goes negative and the next commissions absorb it, so you are never forced to chase money back. New commission is also held for a number of days (30 by default) before it becomes payable.

Does it pay my affiliates?

No. It keeps the ledger and produces a payout CSV that you pay by bank transfer, PayPal, Wise or any other method, then you mark the payout paid. It never holds or moves money and never needs a Stripe API key, only the webhook signing secret.

Are there legal or tax things to know?

Yes. Affiliates generally must disclose the relationship when they promote you, and you may have tax-reporting duties for what you pay them depending on where you both live. This software is not legal or tax advice and you operate the programme.

Same buyer, other jobs: Dunning Engine recovers failed subscription payments, Cancel Flow handles voluntary cancellations, MRR Pulse shows MRR, churn and net revenue retention, Meter Keeper meters usage and previews invoices, Drip Keeper sends lifecycle email sequences, License Keeper issues license keys and Waitlist Keeper runs a referral waitlist before launch, and Testimonial Keeper collects and shows customer testimonials.

No warranty. This tool and the server are provided free and as-is, without warranty of any kind, express or implied, and with no uptime or delivery guarantee. The figures above are expected values from the inputs you type, not a forecast, and not legal, tax, or financial advice. You are the operator, responsible for your own Stripe account, your terms with affiliates and customers, affiliate-disclosure rules, any tax reporting on what you pay, and the consumer-protection and data-protection rules where you live. Everything on this page runs in your browser: nothing you enter is uploaded and the page makes no network requests. Usage counters (opt-out below) stay in your browser's local storage.

render.yaml.text:
# One-click self-deploy: https://render.com/deploy?repo=<your fork URL>
# Render builds the Dockerfile in YOUR account; nothing runs on the author's.
# Needs no Stripe API key: only the webhook signing secret. This server never calls Stripe.
services:
  - type: web
    name: referral-keeper
    runtime: docker
    dockerContext: ventures/referral-keeper
    dockerfilePath: ventures/referral-keeper/Dockerfile
    plan: starter
    healthCheckPath: /healthz
    disk:
      name: state
      mountPath: /data
      sizeGB: 1
    envVars:
      - key: STATE
        value: /data/state.json
      - key: TRUST_PROXY
        value: "true"
      - key: ADMIN_KEY
        generateValue: true
      - key: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
        sync: false
      - key: PUBLIC_URL
        sync: false
      - key: SITE_URL
        sync: false
      - key: PROGRAM_JSON
        value: '{"percent":20,"months":12,"holdDays":30,"minPayout":5000}'
      - key: OPEN_SIGNUP
        value: "false"
      - key: COMPANY_NAME
        sync: false
